messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a hybrid chat payload that accepts both `messages` array and legacy `prompt` string, with clear precedence rules and a lightweight adapter layer.

oliver: high-level ok. main risk is ambiguity for system vs assistant content when we accept prompt. Need normalization.

rahul: agree. suggest rules: 1) if `messages` present, ignore `prompt` except deprecated warnings; 2) if `prompt` present and `messages` absent, convert prompt -> messages by putting prompt as a user message + prepend default system if provided.

maria: +1. also want to support function/tool outputs as first-class assistant roles (assistant.tool) so structured outputs can be typed.

tess: DevEx note — clients will keep sending string prompts for a while. conversion SDK should be in our SDKs and a small server-side adapter for hosted customers.

oliver: perf note — normalization must be cheap and stream-friendly. We should avoid re-serializing large system messages during streaming. Idea: send normalization header only, then stream tokens from normalized source.

rahul: example payload conversion for prompt -> messages:
```
{ \"prompt\": \"Summarize the release notes.\", \"system\": \"Be brief\" }
```
->
```
{ \"messages\": [ {\"role\":\"system\",\"content\":\"Be brief\"}, {\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Summarize the release notes.\"} ] }
```

alex: security question — if we auto-insert system messages, we must surface them in audit logs and make them opt-out for private deployments.

maria: good call. add to acceptance criteria: system injections must be visible in console and audit log. Also mark conversions with a header `x-rw-converted-payload: prompt->messages`.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/hybrid-chat-adapter -> staging at 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z :rocket:

tess: UX ask — when both present, we should return a deprecation warning in response metadata, not error. That will ease client upgrades.

oliver: final decision proposal:
- accept either `messages` or `prompt` (not both recommended)
- normalization rules as rahul suggested
- stream-friendly normalization (header-only)
- assistant.tool role for function outputs; also allow `structured_schema` hint in messages for typed outputs
- audits and headers for converted payloads
- SDK shim + server-side adapter for hosted customers

maria: +1. action items:
- oliver: prototype stream header (ETA 2w)
- tess: SDK shim PR + examples (ETA 1w)
- rahul: update model router to handle assistant.tool role (ETA 2w)
- alex: add audit surface plan (ETA 1w)

maria: if nobody objects by EOD I'll merge this into Chat API spec doc and add to roadmap for next release.

oliver: thumbs up :thumbsup:

rahul: no objections.

maria: thanks everyone — will file follow-ups in product board.
